mainTopic: The strength of מאמר according to בית שמאי: whether it pushes away the צרה fully, and whether it makes נישואין or only אירוסין
overview: The amud asks how strong מאמר, a יבם's verbal betrothal of his יבמה, is according to בית שמאי. An attempted proof from the two-sisters משנה fails, because a מאמר given where יבום is forbidden has no power at all. In רב אשי's version, רבי אלעזר says that for בית שמאי מאמר pushes away the צרה but leaves a remnant, so she still needs חליצה. רבי אבין supports this from the two-sisters משנה. The three-brothers משנה seems to show a full pushing away. The גמרא resolves this: a יבמה fit for full יבום gets a full-strength מאמר, and one who is not fit does not. Then רבה asks whether מאמר makes נישואין or only אירוסין. After אביי's challenges, the practical question becomes whether she still needs a חופה. The גמרא tries to answer from a משנה about a יבם cancelling a שומרת יבם's vows. Two answers block the proof: he may cancel only together with her father, or he cancels alone because the court made him support her.

steps.title: Attempted proof that מאמר does not fully acquire for בית שמאי
steps.stepSummary: If מאמר gave a full קנין, each brother could give מאמר to one sister and acquire her. Since the משנה does not allow this, it seems מאמר does not fully acquire.
steps.simpleTranslation: If you think that for בית שמאי a מאמר acquires the woman completely, then this brother should give מאמר and acquire one sister, and that brother should give מאמר and acquire the other.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא is trying to prove from the case of two sisters falling for יבום that, for בית שמאי, מאמר does not create a complete קנין.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The משנה gives no way for the brothers to do יבום with the two sisters. If מאמר acquired fully, there would be an easy solution: each brother gives מאמר to one sister and she becomes his. The silence of the משנה seems to show that מאמר is weaker than a full קנין.

keyTerms.meaning: And if you were to think (a setup for showing the idea leads to a problem)
A verbal betrothal that a יבם gives his יבמה before יבום
The school of שמאי
A complete acquisition, as strong as full marriage

phrases.english: And if it enters your mind
that levirate betrothal, according to Beit Shammai,
acquires as a complete acquisition,
then this one should perform levirate betrothal and acquire,
and that one should perform levirate betrothal and acquire.

steps.triggerLanguage: וְאִי סָלְקָא דַּעְתָּךְ מַאֲמָר לְבֵית שַׁמַּאי קוֹנֶה קִנְיָן גָּמוּר
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Continues the earlier discussion of the nature of מאמר according to בית שמאי.
steps.raayaObject: That for בית שמאי, מאמר does not create a complete קנין
steps.raayaSupportSource: The משנה of two sisters falling before two brothers, which gives no מאמר solution

steps.title: The same argument would disprove full pushing away
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא pushes back: if מאמר does not acquire, then it must fully push away. But then each brother could give מאמר and push away the other sister, and the משנה doesn't offer that either.
steps.simpleTranslation: Rather, what do you want to say? That it fully pushes away? Then this brother should give מאמר and push away, and that brother should give מאמר and push away.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא attacks the proof from step 1 by showing that the same reasoning would knock out the other possibility too.
steps.deeperAnalysis: If the משנה's silence proves that מאמר doesn't fully acquire, it should equally prove that מאמר doesn't fully push away the other woman. Each brother could have given מאמר to one sister and pushed away the other. Since the argument 'proves too much', the silence of the משנה must have some other explanation.

keyTerms.meaning: Rather, what? (asking what the alternative would be)
Pushes away, removes the other woman from יבום
A complete pushing away

phrases.english: Rather, what?
That it pushes away with a complete pushing away?
Then this one should perform levirate betrothal and push away,
and that one should perform levirate betrothal and push away.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Challenges the proof of step 1 by showing it would rule out the alternative too.
steps.kashyaTarget: The proof that מאמר does not fully acquire
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: The same silence of the משנה would also rule out full pushing away, so the argument proves too much.

steps.title: מאמר only works where יבום is permitted, so there is no proof
steps.stepSummary: You must say that a מאמר given where יבום is permitted pushes away, but one given where it is forbidden does not. The same applies to acquiring: a permitted מאמר acquires and a forbidden one doesn't. So the משנה proves nothing.
steps.simpleTranslation: Rather, what must you say? A מאמר given where it is permitted pushes away, and one given where it is forbidden does not. So too with acquiring: even according to the one who says מאמר fully acquires, a permitted מאמר acquires and a forbidden one does not.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא gives the real reason the משנה offers no מאמר solution, and that reason cancels the proof from step 1.
steps.deeperAnalysis: With the two sisters, יבום is forbidden because each sister is the sister of a woman tied to him by זיקה, so a מאמר there has no power at all. That explains the משנה whether מאמר is a full קנין or not. The next steps (4–7) take up the strength of מאמר for בית שמאי in a different way.

keyTerms.meaning: You have to say
Of permission, given where יבום is allowed
Of prohibition, given where יבום is forbidden
So too, the same applies
According to the one who says

steps.whatToRemember: A מאמר only has power where יבום itself is permitted. That is why the two-sisters משנה cannot tell us how strong מאמר is for בית שמאי.

phrases.english: Rather, what must you say?
Levirate betrothal given under permitted circumstances pushes away,
but one under forbidden circumstances does not push away.
So too with levirate betrothal,
even according to the one who says
that levirate betrothal acquires as a complete acquisition:
levirate betrothal under permitted circumstances acquires,
but under forbidden circumstances it does not acquire.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the problem raised in step 2 and so removes the proof of step 1.
steps.dechiyaRejectionScope: The whole proof from the two-sisters משנה about the strength of מאמר
steps.dechiyaFlawIdentified: The משנה's silence comes from the case being forbidden, not from how strong מאמר is.

steps.title: רב אשי's version: מאמר pushes away but leaves a remnant
steps.stepSummary: רב אשי teaches the discussion differently. רבי אלעזר says that for בית שמאי, מאמר does not fully push away the צרה. It pushes away but leaves a remnant, so the צרה still needs חליצה.
steps.simpleTranslation: רב אשי teaches it this way. רבי אלעזר said: Don't say that for בית שמאי, מאמר pushes away completely, so that her צרה doesn't even need חליצה. Rather, it pushes away but leaves something behind.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא presents a different version, taught by רב אשי, of רבי אלעזר's statement about מאמר according to בית שמאי.
steps.deeperAnalysis: In this version רבי אלעזר states the rule directly. The מאמר is strong enough that the צרה cannot get יבום. But the זיקה is not completely gone, so she still needs חליצה to be released.

keyTerms.meaning: Teaches it this way (introduces a different version)
Her co-wife, the other widow of the same dead brother
The ceremony that releases a widow from יבום
Pushes away but leaves a remnant

steps.whatToRemember: In רב אשי's version, for בית שמאי, מאמר removes the צרה from יבום but not from חליצה.
steps.confusionAlert: Do not think 'pushes away' means the צרה is completely free. Here she is blocked from יבום but still needs חליצה.

phrases.english: Rav Ashi teaches it like this:
Rabbi Elazar said:
Do not say that levirate betrothal, according to Beit Shammai,
pushes away with a complete pushing away,
so that her rival wife does not even require ḥalitza;
rather, it pushes away and leaves a remnant.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Gives a different version of the discussion about מאמר for בית שמאי.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: For בית שמאי, מאמר pushes the צרה away from יבום, but she still needs חליצה.

steps.title: רבי אבין brings support from the משנה of 'they may keep them'
steps.stepSummary: רבי אבין proves from בית שמאי's ruling 'יקיימו' (only after the fact) that מאמר does not fully push away, which supports רבי אלעזר.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי אבין said: We also learned this in a משנה. בית שמאי say: 'They may keep them.' That means they may keep them after the fact, but they may not marry them from the start. Now if you thought that for בית שמאי מאמר fully pushes away, then each brother could do מאמר to one sister and push away the other!
steps.whatsHappening: רבי אבין is bringing a proof from a משנה to back up רבי אלעזר's rule from the last step. בית שמאי only allow the brothers to keep the two sisters after the fact, and that shows מאמר cannot fully push the other sister away.
steps.deeperAnalysis: In the משנה, two sisters fall to two brothers for יבום at the same time. If מאמר fully pushed away, there would be an easy way to allow it from the start: each brother does מאמר to one sister, and that pushes away the other. Since בית שמאי do not give that way out, מאמר must only partly push away, just as רבי אלעזר said.

keyTerms.meaning: We too have learned this (in a משנה): a phrase that brings support from a source
They may keep them (as wives)
From the start, ahead of time (not just after the fact)
A complete pushing away, with nothing left over
And if you would think...

steps.confusionAlert: This looks a lot like step 2, and it is the same argument about pushing away fully. The difference is how it is used. In step 2 it showed that the earlier proof proved too much. Here רבי אבין uses it as real support for רבי אלעזר's rule from step 4.

phrases.english: Rabbi Avin said:
We too have learned this:
Beit Shammai say: they may keep them.
phrases.notes: This is the earlier משנה where two sisters fall to two brothers for יבום at the same time, and the brothers married them anyway.

phrases.english: "They may keep them": yes,
from the start: no.
And if you would think
that מאמר, according to Beit Shammai,
pushes away with a complete pushing away,
then let this brother do מאמר and push away,
and that brother do מאמר and push away!

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Brings support from a משנה for רבי אלעזר's statement in step 4.
steps.raayaObject: רבי אלעזר's rule that for בית שמאי מאמר does not fully push away the צרה.
steps.raayaSupportSource: The משנה where בית שמאי say 'יקיימו' only after the fact, and never offer a way to allow it from the start through מאמר.

steps.title: But another משנה shows מאמר fully pushes away
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא challenges: in the משנה of the three brothers, בית שמאי send the other sister away completely as a wife's sister, which shows מאמר pushes away fully.
steps.simpleTranslation: But the משנה does teach: בית שמאי say: His wife stays with him, and that other one goes out because she is his wife's sister.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא pushes back against רבי אבין's proof. In another משנה, בית שמאי let מאמר push the other sister away completely.
steps.deeperAnalysis: In that משנה, the third brother did מאמר to one widow, and then her sister also fell to him. בית שמאי say the sister simply leaves as 'his wife's sister', with no חליצה needed. That is a complete pushing away, which goes against what רבי אבין just tried to prove.

keyTerms.meaning: His wife stays with him (the woman he did מאמר with)
That other one
A wife's sister, who is forbidden to him

phrases.english: But the משנה does teach:
Beit Shammai say: his wife stays with him,
phrases.notes: 'His wife' is the widow he already did מאמר with, in the משנה of the three brothers.

phrases.english: and that other one goes out
because she is his wife's sister.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Challenges רבי אבין's proof by pointing to a משנה with the opposite result.
steps.kashyaTarget: The claim that for בית שמאי מאמר does not fully push away.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: In the three-brothers משנה, בית שמאי let the sister leave with no חליצה at all, so מאמר did push her away completely.

steps.title: A fully fit יבמה gets a full-strength מאמר
steps.stepSummary: The answer: a יבמה fit for full יבום is also fit for a fully effective מאמר. A יבמה not fit for יבום does not get a fully effective מאמר.
steps.simpleTranslation: Rather: a יבמה who is fit for all of it is fit for part of it. A יבמה who is not fit for all of it is not fit for part of it.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא settles the clash between the two משניות. The strength of מאמר depends on whether this יבמה could have had full יבום.
steps.deeperAnalysis: In the three-brothers משנה, the widow was fully fit for יבום when she fell, so her מאמר is full strength and pushes away completely. In the two-sisters משנה, both fell at the same time and neither was fit for יבום, so a מאמר there would be weak and could not fully push away. That is why בית שמאי there only allow 'יקיימו' after the fact.

keyTerms.meaning: Fit, suitable
For all of it (full יבום)
For part of it (מאמר, the first part of יבום)

steps.whatToRemember: For בית שמאי, מאמר fully pushes away only when the יבמה was fit for full יבום. If she was not fit, the מאמר does not have full strength.

phrases.english: Rather:
a יבמה who is fit for all of it
phrases.notes: 'All of it' means full יבום; 'part of it' means just the מאמר.

phrases.english: is fit for part of it;
a יבמה who is not fit for all of it
is not fit for part of it.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Resolves the contradiction raised in step 6 between the two משניות.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Distinguishing between cases (fit vs. not fit for יבום)
steps.terutzHavaAmina: The two משניות seem to contradict each other about whether מאמר fully pushes away.
steps.terutzMaskana: מאמר fully pushes away when the יבמה is fit for יבום (three brothers), and does not when she is unfit (two sisters falling together).

steps.title: רבה asks: is מאמר marriage or betrothal?
steps.stepSummary: רבה asks whether, for בית שמאי, מאמר creates full marriage (נישואין) or only betrothal (אירוסין).
steps.simpleTranslation: רבה asked: According to בית שמאי, does מאמר make marriage, or does it make betrothal?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא opens a new question about מאמר according to בית שמאי. רבה wants to know how far its power goes.
steps.deeperAnalysis: We already saw that for בית שמאי מאמר can be very strong. Now רבה asks whether it is strong enough to count as full marriage, or only as the first stage, betrothal.

keyTerms.meaning: He asked (a real question he wanted answered)
Full marriage
Betrothal, the first stage of marriage

phrases.english: Rabbah asked:
מאמר, according to Beit Shammai,
does it make marriage,
or does it make betrothal?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Opens a new question about מאמר according to בית שמאי.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: Whether מאמר according to בית שמאי gives the status of full marriage or only betrothal.

steps.title: אביי asks: what law would this matter for?
steps.stepSummary: אביי asks רבה which practical law his question is about.
steps.simpleTranslation: אביי said to him: For what law?
steps.whatsHappening: אביי asks רבה what difference his question makes in practice. This sets up the next step, where the גמרא tries out possible answers.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Before trying to answer רבה, אביי wants to know where the question would change the הלכה. If no law depends on it, the question is not needed.

keyTerms.meaning: For what law? What practical difference does it make?

phrases.english: Abaye said to him:
For what law?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Responds to רבה's question by asking what practical law it is about.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: Which practical law depends on whether מאמר is marriage or betrothal.

steps.title: It can't be about inheritance, טומאה or vows
steps.stepSummary: אביי shows that inheritance, becoming טמא for her, and cancelling her vows cannot be the reason for the question, since even a regular ארוסה does not get these.
steps.simpleTranslation: If you say the question is about inheriting from her, becoming impure for her, and cancelling her vows: now, about an ordinary betrothed woman, רבי חייא taught: A man's betrothed wife: he does not mourn as an אונן for her and does not become impure for her. And she also does not mourn as an אוננת for him and does not become impure for him. If she dies, he does not inherit from her. If he dies, she collects her כתובה. So if he only did מאמר with her, is it even a question?
steps.whatsHappening: אביי tries out the first possible law, inheriting and similar rights, and shows it cannot be what רבה meant. Even a fully betrothed woman does not give her husband these rights, so a woman with only מאמר surely does not.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Inheriting from her, becoming טמא for her, and similar rights come only with full marriage. רבי חייא teaches that a regular ארוסה, betrothed by Torah law, does not give her husband these rights. So when he has done only מאמר with her, the answer is obvious, and רבה's question would add nothing on these points.

keyTerms.meaning: If you say: tries out a possible answer
To inherit from her
To cancel her vows
A mourner on the day of a close relative's death
A betrothed woman (before full marriage)
Is it even a question? (it's obvious)

steps.confusionAlert: אביי is not saying מאמר is less than betrothal for every law. He is only saying that for these rights, which even a regular ארוסה does not give, there is nothing to ask about.

phrases.english: If you say: to inherit from her,
and to become impure for her,
phrases.notes: This is about a כהן, who may become טמא for his wife when she dies.

phrases.english: and to cancel her vows,
now, about an ordinary betrothed woman,
Rabbi Chiya taught:
His betrothed wife:
he does not mourn as an אונן for her, and does not become impure for her;
and likewise she does not mourn as an אוננת
and does not become impure for him;
if she dies, he does not inherit from her;
if he dies, she collects her כתובה;
if he did only מאמר with her, is it even a question?

steps.triggerLanguage: אִילֵּימָא לְיוֹרְשָׁהּ וְלִיטַמֵּא לָהּ וּלְהָפֵר נְדָרֶיהָ
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Tests the first possible practical law for רבה's question and rules it out.
steps.kashyaTarget: The idea that רבה's question is about inheritance, טומאה, or vows.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: Even a regular ארוסה does not give these rights (רבי חייא's ברייתא), so a woman with only מאמר surely does not, and the question would be pointless for these laws.

steps.title: רבה's question is about bringing her to the wedding canopy
steps.stepSummary: After אביי rejected inheritance, טומאה, and vows, the question becomes whether a יבמה who received מאמר must still be brought to a חופה.
steps.simpleTranslation: Rather, the question is about bringing her to the חופה. Does מאמר create full נישואין, so she does not need a חופה? Or does it create only אירוסין, so she does need a חופה?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא finds a new practical difference for רבה's question: whether a חופה is needed after מאמר.
steps.deeperAnalysis: A regular ארוסה must be brought to a חופה before she is fully married. If מאמר equals נישואין, no חופה is needed. If it only equals אירוסין, a חופה would be needed, just as for any betrothed woman.

keyTerms.meaning: handing the bride over to the wedding canopy, the step that completes marriage
full marriage
betrothal, the first stage of marriage
or perhaps

phrases.english: Rather, regarding handing her over to the wedding canopy, what is the law?
Does it create full marriage,
so she does not need to be handed over to a wedding canopy,
or perhaps it creates only betrothal,
so she does need to be handed over to a wedding canopy?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: After step 10 knocked out the other practical results, this step offers חופה as the real case behind the question.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: Whether a יבמה who received מאמר still needs חופה, according to בית שמאי.

steps.title: אביי: she can be taken even against her will, so a canopy cannot be needed
steps.stepSummary: אביי argues that the תורה lets the יבם take the יבמה even against her will with no מאמר at all, so after מאמר he surely needs no חופה.
steps.simpleTranslation: He said to him: Now, even when he did no מאמר, the פסוק says "her יבם shall come upon her," even against her will. Is it even a question once he did מאמר?
steps.whatsHappening: אביי challenges this new version of the question too, arguing from a פסוק that it cannot be a real question.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Without any מאמר, the יבם may complete יבום with relations alone, with no חופה and even without her consent. מאמר only adds a connection between them, so it should not suddenly make a חופה necessary. This is a קל וחומר-style argument.

keyTerms.meaning: "Her brother-in-law shall come upon her" (the פסוק about יבום)
against her will
is it even a question? (meaning: it is obvious)
now, if even (opens a "how much more so" argument)

phrases.english: He said to him:
Now, if he did not do מאמר with her at all,
it is written: "Her brother-in-law shall come upon her",
even against her will,
if he did do מאמר with her, is it even a question?

steps.triggerLanguage: אֲמַר לֵיהּ: הַשְׁתָּא לָא עֲבַד בַּהּ מַאֲמָר
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Attacks the חופה version of the question proposed in step 11.
steps.kashyaTarget: The idea that a יבמה might need חופה after מאמר.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: If a יבמה with no מאמר can be taken by relations alone, even against her will, then מאמר should not add a חופה requirement.

steps.title: רבה: maybe מאמר replaces the levirate bond with a betrothal bond
steps.stepSummary: רבה explains that his question is real: perhaps מאמר removes the יבום-bond and replaces it with a regular betrothal-bond, which would need a חופה.
steps.simpleTranslation: He said to him: I am asking because I might say that whoever does מאמר with his יבמה removes the יבום-bond, and a betrothal-bond takes its place. So what is the law?
steps.whatsHappening: רבה defends his question by giving a reason why מאמר might change the rules.
steps.deeperAnalysis: אביי assumed the יבום-bond, which needs no חופה, is still there after מאמר. רבה suggests that מאמר may make the יבום-bond "fly away" and leave a normal betrothal, and a normal ארוסה needs a חופה. So the question stands: which kind of bond is there now?

keyTerms.meaning: flew away, is removed
the levirate bond tying the יבמה to the יבם
the bond of a regular betrothal
and it takes effect on him

steps.whyThisMatters: It shows that מאמר might not just add to the יבום-bond. It might change the relationship into a different kind of bond with different rules.

phrases.english: He said to him: Because I might say:
anyone who does מאמר with his יבמה
the levirate bond flies away from him,
and a bond of betrothal takes effect on him.
What is the law?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers אביי's challenge in step 12 and restates the question.
steps.terutzHavaAmina: אביי assumed the יבום-bond, which needs no חופה, stays in place after מאמר.
steps.terutzMaskana: Perhaps מאמר removes the יבום-bond and leaves only a betrothal-bond, so a חופה might be needed. The question stands, and step 14 brings a source to try to answer it.

steps.title: Come and hear: cancelling the vows of a woman waiting for her יבם
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא quotes a משנה with a three-way argument about whether a יבם can cancel the vows of a שומרת יבם, setting up an attempt to answer רבה's question.
steps.simpleTranslation: Come and hear: a שומרת יבם, whether there is one יבם or two יבמין. רבי אליעזר says: he may cancel her vows. רבי יהושע says: with one יבם, but not with two. רבי עקיבא says: neither with one nor with two.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא brings a source to try to answer רבה's question. This step only quotes the source. The proof itself comes next.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The משנה asks whether the יבום-bond alone is strong enough for the יבם to cancel her vows, the way a husband can. רבי אליעזר says yes, רבי יהושע says only if there is a single יבם, and רבי עקיבא says never. The גמרא will try to connect this to the question about מאמר.

keyTerms.meaning: a widow waiting for her יבם to do יבום or חליצה
he may cancel (her vows)

steps.confusionAlert: This is not the end of the proof. The גמרא has only quoted the משנה so far. How it answers רבה's question comes after this.

phrases.english: Come and hear: A woman waiting for her יבם,
phrases.notes: This is a משנה from נדרים 74a, about cancelling vows.

phrases.aramaic: בֵּין יָבָם אֶחָד בֵּין שְׁנֵי יְבָמִין —
phrases.english: whether there is one יבם or two יבמין:
רבי אליעזר says: He may cancel her vows.

phrases.aramaic: רַבִּי יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אוֹמֵר: לְאֶחָד וְלֹא לִשְׁנַיִם.
phrases.english: רבי יהושע says: For one, but not for two.

phrases.aramaic: רַבִּי עֲקִיבָא אוֹמֵר: לֹא לְאֶחָד וְלֹא לִשְׁנַיִם.
phrases.english: רבי עקיבא says: Neither for one nor for two.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Brings a source to try to answer the question that רבה restated in step 13.
steps.raayaObject: רבה's question: after מאמר, is the bond a regular betrothal (needing חופה) or still a יבום-bond?
steps.raayaSupportSource: The משנה in נדרים about a יבם cancelling the vows of a שומרת יבם.

steps.title: Recalling the difficulty with רבי אליעזר's view
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא recalls an earlier discussion: the views of רבי עקיבא and רבי יהושע make sense, but why would רבי אליעזר let one brother cancel her vows when there are two brothers?
steps.simpleTranslation: We already discussed this: רבי עקיבא holds there is no real bond even with one brother. רבי יהושע holds there is a bond with one brother but not with two. But for רבי אליעזר, even if he holds there is a bond, that works with one brother. Why should it work with two?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא brings back an earlier discussion of the משנה from Step 14 and points out a problem in רבי אליעזר's view. This sets up the answer in the next step, which will help with רבה's question.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Each opinion in the משנה depends on how strong the זיקה is. רבי עקיבא says there is none, and רבי יהושע says it exists only when it is clear which brother will marry her. רבי אליעזר lets a brother cancel vows even when there are two, but with two brothers we do not know which one she will end up with. So how can either one act as her husband?

keyTerms.meaning: And we discussed it (bringing back an earlier discussion)
The bond between the יבמה and the יבם
With one (brother)
With two (brothers)
Cancels (vows)

phrases.english: And we discussed it:
Granted, Rabbi Akiva holds:
There is no bond, even with one brother.
According to Rabbi Yehoshua: with one brother there is a bond,
with two brothers there is no bond.
But according to Rabbi Eliezer,
even granting that he holds there is a bond,
it makes sense that with one brother he cancels,
but with two brothers, why?

steps.triggerLanguage: וְהָוֵינַן בַּהּ: בִּשְׁלָמָא, רַבִּי עֲקִיבָא סָבַר
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Analyzes the משנה quoted in Step 14 by setting each opinion against the strength of the זיקה.
steps.kashyaTarget: רבי אליעזר's ruling that a יבם can cancel vows even when there are two brothers
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: With two brothers, it is unknown which one will marry her, so no single brother should count as her husband.

steps.title: The case is after מאמר, following בית שמאי
steps.stepSummary: רבי אמי explains that רבי אליעזר is talking about a case where one brother already did מאמר, and he follows בית שמאי, who say מאמר is a complete acquisition.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי אמי said: We are dealing with a case where one brother did מאמר with her. This follows בית שמאי, who say מאמר acquires her completely.
steps.whatsHappening: רבי אמי solves the problem with two brothers. After one brother has done מאמר, it is clear which brother is her husband.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Once a brother does מאמר, he has singled her out, so having two brothers no longer matters. Following בית שמאי, his מאמר is a full acquisition, so he can cancel her vows. This answer becomes the basis for the attempted proof in the next step.

keyTerms.meaning: What case are we dealing with here? (used to narrow the case)
A יבם's betrothal of the יבמה, done with money or a document
The school of שמאי
A complete acquisition

phrases.english: And Rabbi Ami (bar Ahava) said:
phrases.notes: Some versions have the words in round brackets and some leave them out.

phrases.english: With what case are we dealing here?
For example, where he did מאמר with her,
and it follows בית שמאי, who say:
מאמר acquires as a complete acquisition.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the difficulty of Step 15 by limiting the case to one where מאמר was done.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Limiting the case (אוקימתא) and linking it to בית שמאי
steps.terutzHavaAmina: רבי אליעזר lets a brother cancel vows even when it is unclear which of two brothers she belongs to.
steps.terutzMaskana: The case is after one brother did מאמר, which for בית שמאי is a complete acquisition.

steps.title: Attempted proof that מאמר creates full marriage
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא tries to answer רבה: the יבם cancels her vows alone, and that only works if מאמר creates נישואין, because a regular ארוס cannot cancel alone.
steps.simpleTranslation: If you say מאמר creates full marriage, that is why he can cancel her vows. But if you say it creates only betrothal, how can he cancel? We learned that for a betrothed young woman, her father and her husband together cancel her vows.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא uses רבי אמי's answer to try to settle רבה's question. If the יבם can cancel alone, then מאמר must make her fully married, so no חופה is needed.
steps.deeperAnalysis: A regular ארוס cannot cancel vows by himself; he needs the father to join him. The משנה seems to say the יבם cancels alone after מאמר. That would make him like a full husband, which means מאמר creates נישואין and no חופה is needed.

keyTerms.meaning: Full marriage
Betrothal (the first stage of marriage)
A betrothed young woman

steps.confusionAlert: Do not think a regular ארוס has no power over his wife's vows. He does have a say, but only together with her father. The question here is whether the יבם can cancel alone.

phrases.english: Granted, if you say it creates full marriage,
phrases.notes: "It" means the מאמר. This is coming back to רבה's question.

phrases.english: that is why he cancels.
But if you say it creates only betrothal,
how can he cancel?
But we learned: a betrothed young woman,
her father and her husband cancel her vows!

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Builds on רבי אמי's answer to try to settle רבה's question from Steps 11 and 13.
steps.raayaObject: That מאמר creates נישואין, so no חופה is needed
steps.raayaSupportSource: The משנה lets the יבם cancel after מאמר, while the משנה about a נערה המאורסה requires both father and husband.

steps.title: He cancels only together with the father
steps.stepSummary: רב נחמן בר יצחק rejects the proof: "he cancels" may mean he cancels together with her father, just like a regular ארוס.
steps.simpleTranslation: רב נחמן בר יצחק said: What does "he cancels" mean? He cancels together with her father.
steps.whatsHappening: רב נחמן בר יצחק breaks the proof. The משנה does not have to mean the יבם cancels alone.
steps.deeperAnalysis: If the יבם cancels together with the father, he is acting like an ordinary ארוס. That fits a view that מאמר creates only אירוסין. So the proof fails, and רבה's question about חופה stays open.

keyTerms.meaning: What does it mean?
In partnership, together (with her father)

phrases.english: Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak said:
What does "he cancels" mean? He cancels in partnership.
phrases.notes: The partner is her father, just like in the משנה about a betrothed young woman.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Rejects the proof of Step 17 by reading the משנה differently.
steps.dechiyaRejectionScope: The whole proof that מאמר creates נישואין
steps.dechiyaFlawIdentified: It assumed the יבם cancels alone. He may cancel together with the father, which fits מאמר as אירוסין.

steps.title: How does this fit רבי אלעזר's view of מאמר?
steps.stepSummary: רבי אלעזר says that for בית שמאי, מאמר only pushes away the צרה. If so, why should the יבם cancel vows at all, even together with the father?
steps.simpleTranslation: And according to רבי אלעזר, who said that for בית שמאי מאמר acquires only to push away the צרה, why should he cancel even in partnership?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא challenges רב נחמן בר יצחק's reading using רבי אלעזר's limited view of מאמר.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רבי אלעזר describes מאמר for בית שמאי as weak: it only blocks the other wife, the צרה. Something that weak does not seem to give the יבם even the power of a regular ארוס. So how could he cancel vows even together with the father?

keyTerms.meaning: To push away, to exclude
The other wife of the brother who died
Only

phrases.english: And according to Rabbi Elazar, who said:
According to בית שמאי, מאמר does not acquire
except to push away the צרה only,
why does he cancel in partnership?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Challenges the reading of Step 18, and רבי אמי's answer, from the view of רבי אלעזר.
steps.kashyaTarget: The claim that after מאמר, following בית שמאי, the יבם cancels vows together with the father
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: If מאמר only pushes away the צרה, it creates no real betrothal, so the יבם should have no power over her vows at all.

steps.title: רבי אלעזר's limit was about חליצה, not vows
steps.stepSummary: רבי אלעזר explains that "only to push away the צרה" meant only that a גט is not enough and she also needs חליצה. He never said מאמר has no effect on vows.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי אלעזר can say to you: I said it acquires only to push away the צרה to teach that a גט is not enough for her and she also needs חליצה. Did I say anything about cancelling her vows?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers for רבי אלעזר by narrowing what he meant. His statement was about how to end the bond, not about vows.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The word "only" in רבי אלעזר's statement teaches that מאמר does not fully replace the יבום bond. So if they separate, a גט alone does not end it, and חליצה is also needed. That does not stop מאמר from working like אירוסין for vows, so the יבם can cancel together with the father.

keyTerms.meaning: He can say to you (answering for someone)
A bill of divorce
The ceremony that releases a יבמה from יבום
To cancel her vows

steps.whatToRemember: The attempt to prove from vow-cancelling that מאמר creates נישואין fails. The יבם may cancel only together with the father, like an ארוס. Even רבי אלעזר's limited view of מאמר fits this, because his limit was only about needing חליצה. רבה's question about חופה remains open.

phrases.english: Rabbi Elazar can say to you:
Say that I said it does not acquire
except to push away the צרה only,
meaning a גט is not enough for her
but she also needs חליצה.
Regarding cancelling her vows, did we say that?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the challenge of Step 19 by limiting what רבי אלעזר's statement covers.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Limiting the scope of an earlier statement
steps.terutzHavaAmina: רבי אלעזר's "only to push away the צרה" means מאמר has no other effect, including on vows.
steps.terutzMaskana: His limit only teaches that she needs חליצה as well as a גט. For vows, מאמר can still work, so the יבם cancels together with the father.

steps.title: The משנה says 'he cancels,' not 'they cancel'
steps.stepSummary: As a second answer, רבי אלעזר attacks רב נחמן בר יצחק's reading. The משנה uses the singular 'יפר,' which means the יבם cancels alone, not together with the father.
steps.simpleTranslation: And if you want, say a different answer: רבי אלעזר could tell you, 'Does the explanation of רב נחמן בר יצחק really work? Does the משנה say "they cancel"? It says "he cancels"!'
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא offers a second way רבי אלעזר could answer. He turns the question back on רב נחמן בר יצחק and shows that his explanation does not fit the wording of the משנה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: In step 18, רב נחמן בר יצחק said the יבם cancels together with her father. But the משנה uses the singular 'יפר,' which points to one person cancelling alone. So רבי אלעזר will need a different reason why the יבם can cancel alone, and that reason must have nothing to do with מאמר.

keyTerms.meaning: And if you want, say: this brings a second, alternative answer
Does it work out well? This is a challenge.
He cancels (singular)
They cancel (plural)
It teaches (the wording of the משנה)

steps.confusionAlert: רבי אלעזר is not agreeing that the יבם cancels alone because of מאמר. He agrees the יבם cancels alone, but he is about to give a totally different reason.

phrases.english: And if you want, say:
Rabbi Elazar could say to you:

phrases.aramaic: וּלְרַב נַחְמָן בַּר יִצְחָק מִי נִיחָא?
phrases.english: And according to Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak, does it work out well?
phrases.notes: He means רב נחמן בר יצחק's idea from step 18 that the יבם cancels together with the father.

phrases.english: Does it teach "they cancel"?
It teaches "he cancels."

steps.triggerLanguage: וְאִיבָּעֵית אֵימָא, אָמַר לָךְ רַבִּי אֶלְעָזָר: וּלְרַב נַחְמָן בַּר יִצְחָק מִי נִיחָא
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Offers a second response for רבי אלעזר instead of the answer in step 20. It starts by rejecting רב נחמן בר יצחק's reading from step 18.
steps.kashyaTarget: רב נחמן בר יצחק's explanation that the יבם cancels vows together with the father
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: The משנה uses the singular 'יפר,' which means one person cancels alone. That contradicts the idea that the father and יבם cancel together.

steps.title: The case is where the court ordered him to support her
steps.stepSummary: רבי אלעזר explains the משנה as a special case: the יבמה went to בית דין, and they ordered the יבם to provide her food from his own property.
steps.simpleTranslation: Rather, what case are we dealing with here? She went to court, and the court ordered that her food must come from his property.
steps.whatsHappening: רבי אלעזר gives a new explanation of the משנה. It is talking about a יבמה whom בית דין put under the יבם's financial support.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Now the reason the יבם cancels alone is not the power of מאמר. It is the fact that he feeds her. This lets the singular 'יפר' stay as written without proving that מאמר creates נישואין.

keyTerms.meaning: What case are we dealing with here? This is used to narrow the case.
She stood in court (she brought her case to בית דין)
They ruled that she gets food (support)
From his property (the יבם's)

phrases.english: Rather, what case are we dealing with here?
Where she went to court,
phrases.notes: She is stuck waiting for the יבם, so she goes to בית דין.

phrases.english: and they ruled that her food comes from his property.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: After rejecting רב נחמן בר יצחק's reading, רבי אלעזר gives his own explanation of the משנה.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Limiting the case (אוקימתא): the משנה describes a יבם whom the court made responsible for her food.
steps.terutzHavaAmina: The יבם cancels alone, so it seemed that מאמר must create full נישואין.
steps.terutzMaskana: He cancels alone because the court made him support her, not because of the power of מאמר.

steps.title: A woman vows with the agreement of the one who supports her
steps.stepSummary: The new explanation is based on רב פנחס in the name of רבא: every woman who vows does so with her husband's agreement. A יבם who feeds her is treated the same way, so he can cancel alone.
steps.simpleTranslation: This follows רב פנחס in the name of רבא, because רב פנחס said in the name of רבא: Any woman who makes a vow makes it with her husband's agreement.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא brings the source behind רבי אלעזר's explanation. It is a rule that a woman makes her vows with the agreement of the man she depends on.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Since she depends on the man who feeds her, we assume her vows were made with his agreement in mind. That gives him the power to cancel them alone. In our case the יבם feeds her by court order, so he can cancel alone, and the משנה gives no proof for רבה about מאמר.

keyTerms.meaning: In the name of רבא
A woman who makes a vow
With her husband's agreement (based on his consent)

steps.whatToRemember: The proof from step 17 is rejected a second way. The יבם can cancel her vows alone because the court made him support her, and a woman vows with the agreement of the one who supports her. So the משנה proves nothing about whether מאמר creates נישואין.
steps.whyThisMatters: It shows that the power to cancel vows can come from her depending on him for support, not only from the strength of the marriage bond.

phrases.english: And this follows Rav Pinchas in the name of Rava,
because Rav Pinchas said in the name of Rava:
Any woman who makes a vow
makes her vow with her husband's agreement.
phrases.notes: Here the יבם who feeds her counts like the husband for this rule, so he can cancel alone.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Gives the legal source for step 22's explanation. It explains why being supported by the יבם gives him power over her vows.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: Any woman who vows does so with the agreement of her husband (the one she depends on). So he can cancel her vows.
